title: WTAgent Reliable Autonomous Development Roadmap
goal: Accept a high-level development goal, decompose it into independently verified tasks, execute and recover safely across workers and conversations, and deliver evidence-backed results.

baseline.evidence: Seven relevant test files: 140 passed, zero failed. Not a Windows/browser soak certification.

relationshipToLegacyPlan: Keep docs/autonomy-tasks.json unchanged. This is the canonical implementation roadmap for the next incremental development cycle, not an automatic authorization to execute privileged actions.

executionPolicy.order: Topological order of dependencies, then array order
executionPolicy.verification: Evidence must come from an independent tool/verifier, never only from model prose. A file hash is not functional proof.
executionPolicy.progress: Mark task IN_PROGRESS before editing, VERIFYING during tests; VERIFIED only after a successful scoped commit. Persist commitSha and test evidence. Do not change completed task statuses without documented remediation.
executionPolicy.recovery: On restart inspect Git HEAD/worktree and this document. If a task was interrupted, reconcile the exact scoped commit and tests before replaying. Do not use git reset/clean, overwrite unrelated changes, or replay uncertain side effects.
executionPolicy.permissions: Local scoped commits are approved. No automatic git push, PR merge, npm publish, global install, live-account interaction, irreversible command, or restart of the currently running Supervisor. Follow existing runtime policy and require appropriate approval.
executionPolicy.release: Versioned packaging/tagging and switching the running instance are separate gated operations. Source edits do not hot-reload into a running Node process.
executionPolicy.failure: Never mark passing solely on changed files. Persist diagnostic code, bound retries, and stop on unknown side effects or exhausted budgets.
executionPolicy.audit: Each task has commitSha, testEvidence, notes. Never stage unrelated files, credentials, browser profiles, or archives.

tasks.title: Expand acceptance schema for command checks
tasks.deliverable: Validate bounded, explicit command acceptance entries while preserving legacy file-only plans.
acceptance: Reject arbitrary programs, invalid argv/cwd, and shell injection
Schema unit tests include positive and negative cases
tasks.notes: Command checks accepted as declarations only; no execution until FV-02, fail-closed on create/load.

tasks.title: Execute independent bounded command checks
tasks.deliverable: Run allowlisted verification commands separately from the Worker under explicit execution boundaries.
acceptance: Record true exit status, timeout, stderr and spawn errors
No shell execution, path escape or arbitrary code elevation
tasks.notes: Real bounded npm/node acceptance; fail-closed spawn, timeout, unknown completion, nonzero exit; persisted command proofs and crash-safe no-replay behavior. OS-level sandbox not claimed.

tasks.title: Persist and bind verification evidence
tasks.deliverable: Persist verification command, environment identity, result and artifact fingerprints atomically.
acceptance: Evidence is versioned and tied to workspace/plan/task
Missing or tampered evidence fails closed

tasks.title: Verify completed tasks during resume
tasks.deliverable: Resume validates persisted evidence and detects relevant source/verification drift without repeating side effects.
acceptance: Idempotent resume never duplicates Worker operations
Interrupted verification retries only safe checks

tasks.title: Add test and integration acceptance
tasks.deliverable: Add test-suite and repeatable localhost integration verification with structured results.
acceptance: Failed/zero/skipped required tests do not pass
Integration verifies observable output not a model claim

tasks.title: Gate whole-goal completion on final verification
tasks.deliverable: Distinguish artifact verified, task verified, and goal delivered.
acceptance: A modified file with failing behavior cannot succeed
All required checks must be evidenced
Deliverable report identifies any unverified capability

tasks.title: Fault-inject outbound and tool-result boundaries
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic tests of uncertain send, dropped acknowledgement, duplicate callback and restart.
acceptance: No blind resend of commit-unknown outbound

tasks.title: Harden reconciliation diagnostics and retry policy
tasks.deliverable: Classified, bounded reconcile/retry/block decisions with sanitized diagnostics.
acceptance: All attempts and stop reasons persist

tasks.title: Reproducible Windows worker soak harness
tasks.deliverable: Bounded repeatable 50+ tool-cycle test with worker crash and transport failures.
acceptance: No duplicated side effects on replay
Separately labels mocked test evidence versus live browser smoke

tasks.title: Introduce explicit failure classification
tasks.deliverable: Separate retryable, verification failure, external blocker, uncertain side effect and permanent failure.

tasks.title: Bound autonomous repair attempts
tasks.deliverable: Durable attempt budgets and same-error loop detection.

tasks.title: Generate constrained repair subtasks
tasks.deliverable: Convert safe, evidenced failures into bounded repair tasks without altering completed checks.
acceptance: Repair instruction cites actual failure evidence
Uncertain side effects never auto-repair by replay

tasks.title: Repair, reverify, and resume original task
tasks.deliverable: Close the failure-resolution loop using durable checkpoints.
acceptance: Safe repair passes independent verification before advancing
Restart midway does not duplicate side effects

tasks.title: Support revisioned task DAG changes
tasks.deliverable: Permit bounded replanning of incomplete nodes with immutable verified evidence.
acceptance: Concurrent plan revision conflicts are detected

tasks.title: Detect investigation-only stalls
tasks.deliverable: Use observed tool events and deliverables to detect repeated non-progress.
acceptance: Trigger limited replan without falsely marking done

tasks.title: Execute revised plan and preserve progress
tasks.deliverable: Continue revised plan after crashes with only remaining work.
acceptance: Three or more dependent tasks complete in order
No duplicated commit or side-effect operation

tasks.title: Produce canonical context manifest
tasks.deliverable: Bind goal/plan/task IDs, verified evidence, source SHA, hazards and next action into a bounded handoff.
acceptance: State comes from checkpoints not model summaries
No credentials or raw private logs
Missing canonical state cannot be invented

tasks.title: Automatically rotate only at clean checkpoints
tasks.deliverable: Context pressure requests a safe fresh conversation when all pending operations settle.
acceptance: No rotation with pending outbound/tool result/side effect
No mutation of existing browser identity
Blocked rotation safely pauses rather than losing work

tasks.title: Resume planned work after conversation rotation
tasks.deliverable: Verify manifest and resume the correct task in a new conversation.
acceptance: No re-execution of uncertain side effects

tasks.title: Durable orchestrator loop
tasks.deliverable: Dedicated bounded scheduler over goal/planner/executor/verifier rather than a single CLI timebox.

tasks.title: Restart recovery and process ownership
tasks.deliverable: Recover safe tasks after service crash and prevent duplicate active schedulers.
acceptance: Stale-owner recovery is explicit and audited

tasks.title: Heartbeats and human approval notifications
tasks.deliverable: Expose actionable heartbeat, stalled reason and required approval without privileged auto-approval.

tasks.title: Durable progress and tool echo
tasks.deliverable: Current goal/task/action, test status, attempt counts and next step visible from durable events.
acceptance: Reattach after restart shows accurate state

tasks.title: Goal-wide resource budgets
tasks.deliverable: Persisted time/call/attempt/concurrency limits with safe pausing.
acceptance: Exhaustion cannot be mistaken for success

tasks.title: Evidence-backed final delivery report
tasks.deliverable: Compare original goal acceptance with actual artifacts/tests, commits, limitations and approvals.
acceptance: No status inferred from model prose

tasks.title: Isolated candidate verification against known-good supervisor
tasks.deliverable: Keep supervisor/verifier running trusted code while exercising candidate in disposable worktree.
acceptance: Reports exact candidate SHA and skipped live checks

tasks.title: Approval-gated promotion and rollback
tasks.deliverable: Auditable promote/rollback procedure tied to approved version and exact verified candidate.
acceptance: Rollback points to exact prior artifact

tasks.title: Final end-to-end autonomous delivery regression
tasks.deliverable: Demonstrate multistep goal, real verifier, repair, replan, rotation, restart and evidence-backed completion.
acceptance: No duplicated side effects or false success
All phases traceable to independent commits and verified evidence
